contract.note: The employment context reasonably makes replacement about jobs. Commercial deliveries need not fall outside the pilot exception; Marcus's knowledge remains essential.

reviews.rationale: The packet establishes neither a driverless operation meeting both contradiction requirements nor an AI-caused radiologist job replacement. It also lacks sufficient evidence to establish both negative assertions.

contract.note: Broad, continuing learning is an ordinary reading of the surrounding examples. Narrow few-shot success alone does not establish the childlike capability asserted to be absent.

evidence.note: Gato supplies a relevant few-shot analogy, but the earlier experiments do not establish continuing childlike learning across the required breadth.
GPT-3's earlier few-shot results challenge a blanket denial of analogous abilities, but neither its successes nor weaknesses settle the contextual October 2022 claim.

reviews.rationale: The few-shot findings are material counterevidence to a narrower literal reading. Under the fair contextual reading, the packet establishes neither a childlike continuing learner nor a sufficiently broad evaluation demonstrating its absence in the target period.
